name: Methow River (Winthrop – Twisp)
blurb: Western-town float from Winthrop's Red Barn — tubers in late summer, quick spring water.

sections.notes: Popular late-summer tube float. Big Eddy is a steep climb up to the highway. AW rates the whole 50-mi reach II(III).
Tricky landing at Twisp: cross the incoming Twisp River current and catch a small eddy river right; steep carry.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
